description: The chart represents the distribution of various input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs during WildChat conversations. The chart is divided into nine slices, each representing a different category. The categories and their corresponding approximate percentages are: Draft/Other (26.4%, red), Press Release (18.7%, yellow), External News Article (18.1%, green), Interview (8.8%, dark blue), Organizational Report (7.7%, pink), Event Posting (6.6%, purple), Organizational Website (4.9%, light purple), Intra-agency news article (4.9%, light blue), Email (2.7%, light green), and Social Media Post (1.1%, orange). The chart includes percentage labels outside the slices, and the categories are color-coded, but there is no legend. The slices are not ordered in a particular way, and no slice is visually emphasized.
caption_used: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of various input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs during WildChat conversations, matched to online articles from two identified news agencies. The largest category is 'Draft/Other,' accounting for approximately 26.4% of the total, followed by 'Press Release' at 18.7%. 'External News Article' and 'Interview' are the next largest categories, representing 18.1% and 8.8%, respectively. Notably, 'Organizational Report' consistently exceeds 'Event Posting,' with 9.7% compared to 6.6%. Additionally, 'Social Media Post' shows a slight increase over 'Email,' with 1.5% versus 2.7%. The chart provides a clear overview of the relative proportions of each stimulus type, with all categories labeled and color-coded for clarity.
